judgment.notes: M006 is applied with α=ℝ, countable index ℕ, Lebesgue measure as μ and family J. Lebesgue measure has the canonical set-evaluation and outer-measure structures; no measurability of the original W_i is required. The explicit enlargement gives I⊆⋃J_i, with measure monotonicity checked in BG004. M007 at endpoints 0,1 gives volume(I)=1. M008 applies at the displayed finite infimum/supremum endpoints for nonempty bounded W_i; their order and positive margins give the stated nonnegative length, and empty J_i are handled separately. N001 is used only at positive exponents on the metric spaces ℝ and ℝ^{n+1}, with its strict dimension comparisons or stated measure-to-dimension implications. All background applications have their local signs, finiteness and domains checked in the saved notes. There are no E applications.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
